snippet.title: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses [TEASER]
snippet.description:
You are a traveler with a cracked soul and a house on wheels (RV). Your mission is to listen to those standing on the edge and find the right words before the strangers fall silent forever.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4176620/
